notes.title: Update V0.5 Released
notes.notes:
Hello Monster Girl Lovers!

We're back with another update for Monster Girl Descent.

This is mostly just an update with a multitude of long standing bug fixes and tweaks, we'll be back with new content very soon!

[b]Changelog:
[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed Goddess Statue not removing curse cards correctly
[*] Fixed butler saying you contributed to the town even if you didn't, his dialogue now only changes after you have upgraded the castle
[*] Fixed trusty shovel achievement triggering before you decide to use it
[*] Fixed rocks not showing on minimap on some maps
[*] Fixed crashes that occurred when using certain items
[*] Fixed Bomb items not working
[*] Fixed Full draw potion and Mulligan Draught causing crashes
[*] Fixed various typos and formatting errors
[/list]

Coming Next:

H-Scene for the Princess
Gobbo's shop and card rewards will take the player's class into account when deciding what is available for more class unique rewards.
More unique card reward drops depending on your class
More Monster Girls
More unique abilities and mechanics to all enemies, each one should now feel different to fight.
More Cards
More town locations and upgrade rewards.
More dungeon events, objects, rooms and locations.
A way to actually clear the game/end a successful run

notes.title: Update 4 Released | New Monster Girl | New Systems
notes.notes:
Hello Monster Girl Lovers!

We're back with another major update for Monster Girl Descent which adds a new monster girl, the Harpy Girl.  This update also includes new events, new items and more a couple of new artifacts!

We've focused a lot of the work for this update on improving the foundations of the roguelite element of the game. There should be a lot more events now where you'll need to balance risk and reward whilst exploring. We also have a better base to add many more events, items and more in a smoother manner in future updates.

[b]Please be warned this update will clear your inventory on existing saves. Artifacts will not be affected.
[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762340/db9cddde6d9c121a56d1bec5f0c2437f98f2a72e.png[/img]

[b]Changelog:
[/b]
[b]New Content:
[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Added new monster girl, the Harpy Girl. She can be found in the cave and currently has one h-scene. Watch out for her powerful talons![/b]
[*] Interactable objects can now randomly spawn, some will have positive effects, others negative. Will the trade-off be worth it? (This system will be expanded with new objects and events in future updates)
[*] The minimap has been upgraded, you can now enlarge it to see more clearly by clicking it or pressing "N".
[*] Added a bunch of new random events that can occur upon entering a new floor. Is the risk worth the reward?
[*] Added some new artifacts.
[*] Added  a visible health bar and nameplate for all enemies, this will also show any enemy states.
[*] Added a new item system. You can now only carry a maximum of 3 consumable items, it was previously too easy to stack things like healing items and deck bombs. This should add another layer of difficulty and strategy to the game.
[*] You can now actually get beer at the tavern if you have an available item slot and don't already have one. (The price of the beer depends on the level of the tavern.)
[*] Added more room layouts and room types.
[*] 
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762340/5ccb61577bc526337023bada17574fce44a2541b.png[/img]

[b]Fixes and Tweaks:
[/b]
[list]
[*] The Shops and Markets in town have been updated with new interfaces to align with the changes to the way items work.
[*] The depth of field (blur) effect is now disabled by default for new installations. Reminder: It can be turned off/on and the strength adjusted in the settings!
[*] Fixed parasite girl image not disappearing if you tell her no.
[*] Fixed some issues with treasure chest spawns
[*] Lots of fixes to the minimap.
[*] Adjusted the starting cards for each class, the player starts with less super powerful cards to make it more rewarding when you do get powerful cards.
[*] Refresh no longer takes the player over their max energy points. (for now).
[*] Changed error text for trusty shovel boss floor to be more grammatically correct.
[*] Adjusted the values of some overpowered cards such as singularity.
[*] The battle log has been slowed down slightly to hopefully show attacks and effects more clearly.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762340/aada914bfe1830bf882ac3c68511fd338b560635.png[/img]

[b]Coming Next:
[/b]
[list]
[*] H-Scene for the Princess
[*] Gobbo's shop and card rewards will take the player's class into account when deciding what is available for more class unique rewards.
[*] More unique card reward drops depending on your class
[*] More Monster Girls
[*] More unique abilities and mechanics to all enemies, each one should now feel different to fight.
[*] More Cards
[*] More town locations and upgrade rewards.
[*] More dungeon events, objects, rooms and locations.
[*] A way to actually clear the game/end a successful run
[/list]

notes.title: Update 3 Released | New Monster Girl!
notes.notes:
Hello Monster Girl Connoisseurs,

We're back with another update today which adds a new monster girl, the Parasite Girl.  We've also added many more room types and layouts to make the dungeon more interesting to explore. We've also made some fixes and tweaks based on your valuable feedback!

[b]Changelog:
[/b]
[b]New Content:
[/b]
[list]
[*] Added new monster girl, the Parasite Girl. She can be found in the cave and currently has one h-scene. Watch out for her attacks, she might even infect you!
[*] You can be infected by the Parasite Girl to gain some powerful skills. However, her presence in your body will also have negative effects!
[*] Added more room layouts and room types.
[*] Added 15 new skill cards.
[*] Gobbo now stocks a wider variety of cards in his shop.
[/list]


[b]Fixes and Tweaks:
[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed the game crash caused by the Arogane H-scene. This should also hopefully fix old saves encountering this issue.
[*] Fixed portal disappearing if you select the "Cancel" command in boss rooms.
[*] Fixed text wrapping on some tooltips.
[*] Added yes/no check to the doorway that enters the cave to stop you being forced into it if you change your mind.
[*] Treasure chest spawn locations have been increased in larger rooms to make their placement more randomised (spawn rate is still the same). This system will also allow for the spawning of other random things in later updates. We'll also be able to further randomise layouts via this system.
[*] Moved enemy, event and camp events onto this new spawning system so that we can unify edits across them.
[*] Balance to some existing card costs, damage and other stats.
[/list]


We're so happy to see you all playing the game and having fun! 

We've also had some great feedback. Thank you!

Kind regards,

MGGEDev

notes.title: Update 0.2 Released | New Content, Fixes and Tweaks
notes.notes:
Hello Everyone,

Thanks so much for your feedback so far, we're here with another update today which adds some more content, especially for the town upgrades. Also lots of tweaks and fixes based on the feedback so far.

[b]Changelog:
[/b]
[list]
[*] Added new H-Scene in the Tavern when Tavern is Level 3
[*] Added new H-Scene in the Church when Church is Level 3
[*] Added a way to freely clear all curse cards at once at the church so you can clear negative cards between runs
[*] Added a cancel button to card removal and upgrade menu so you aren't locked into it if you change your mind
[*] Removing normal cards at the church now has a flat cost of 50 gold (reduces to 25 at Church Level 2) to prevent it being too easy to cheese (for example removing all cards except a few mega powerful cards) It should be harder to do and more satisfying if you achieve it
[*] Added a remove card option to Gobbo's shop that works the same way as removing in the church, he'll remove one card for a fee, he will still charge for curse cards individually as they are supposed to be part of the challenge whilst in the cave, they can all be removed for free if you manage to escape the cave. He can only do one removal each time you find him. The price starts at 50 gold and increases by 25 gold every time you use it, The price resets if you leave the cave.
[*] Added Quit to Desktop Buttons to Title Screen and Options Menu
[*] Name input scene now accepts keyboard typing as input 
[*] Card mechanics and special keywords are now highlighted and have explanations
[*] Added more characters to some locations after upgrading parts of the town
[*] Fixed deck bomb damage being the same on all sizes
[*] Fixed rare bug that could cause boss floors to add to the floor count incorrectly and trap you in a loop of seeing the boss again
[/list]


[b]Known issues:
[/b]
Minimap sometimes shows items or people that are not there, investigating a fix for another update.


Whilst controller support is not currently advertised or implemented, we've made some tweaks internally to hopefully better support them down the line. The controls may be a little bit better now.

We hope you've all had fun with the game so far, this is just the beginning!

Kind regards,

MGGEDev

notes.title: Monster Girl Descent - First Early Access Version Now Released!
notes.notes:
It is finally here!

We've been quietly working away on this new project for quite some time now. We had an amazing response to the demo we released, which enabled us to make tweaks, fixes and changes based on the feedback of our players.

We can now proudly say...

[b]The first Early Access version of Monster Girl Descent is now released!
[/b]
[b]State of the Game:
[/b]
The game is  still unfinished and does not fully represent our vision for the final version, however we are confident it is in a great state for players to enjoy. In terms of features, we have implemented most of the features we wanted the game to have. The main thing we need to do is to add plenty more content!

Being in early access will allow us to do this as well as getting valuable feedback from you all!

Such is the way with early access games, If you want to play a longer, more fleshed out and polished game, it might be worth waiting for more major updates to be released before taking the plunge. Please keep an eye open for updates in the meantime, we'll be so happy if you follow us along this journey.

There should at least be a few hours of gameplay for players if we consider runs with every class, upgrading the town and collecting all the current monster girl scenes. These things will be expanded upon over time, especially more monster girls! 

As it is a roguelike/roguelite in style, we've tried our best to make every run feel a bit different, whether it is the random maps or random events, even the items and cards you discover. We have hundreds at the moment, but as development continues we'll be adding hundreds more!

Most importantly, More monster girls and their saucy scenes are coming very soon!

We've been very eager to get something playable into the hands of those that have been eagerly anticipating the game and supporting us to get to this point. We appreciate all of your support and wanted to prove that we are making something that is worthy of supporting.

We hope this will serve as an example of what more is to come when we eventually reach our 1.0 vision of this game and our Monster Girl universe!

[b]We anticipate the game will be in early access for up to a year as long as we don't experience any delays or crazy life events. One thing is for certain, the game will not be abandoned.[/b] The development will continue until we believe the game is done, and if the demand is still there, updates after 1.0.

Things will very likely be quite different later on in the development of the game, things will be reworked, redone and tweaked. Most importantly, things will be much more fleshed out, content rich and polished!

[b]This version of the game currently includes the following features:
[/b]
[list]
[*] 5 Different Monster Girl Boss Encounters
[*] H-Scenes featuring 10 Monster Girls
[*] Card based Combat with many builds and abilities
[*] 3D First Person Cave delving action!
[*] A randomly generated cave with many secrets that changes every run
[*] Upgrade your town to unlock more features and permanent upgrades for your next run into the dungeon!
[*] Maybe some pesky bugs waiting to strike (please let us know if you find any!)
[/list]


[b]Coming in the first content update will be:
[/b]
[list]
[*] More Monster Girls
[*] More Unique Attacks For Each Monster Girl
[*] More Cave Rooms and Biomes
[*] More Artifacts
[*] More Cards
[*] More Available Town Upgrades
[*] Rewrites for old scenes
[/list]

The first content update will  be coming in two to three weeks time.

[b]Ending Note:
[/b]
Being the second game for our little studio, we've made sure to use the things we've learned whilst developing Monster Girl Invasion RPG as we craft another Monster Girl Adventure. It has been so fun bringing another world to life for our players and Monster Girl lovers around he world.

We hope this will serve as a decent taster for you to look forward to what comes next for the game, plenty more content, more cards and some wonderfully sexy monster girls are on their way!

Any constructive feedback is welcomed, please reach out to us via your preferred channel, be it via the steam forums, discord or simply sending us a private message or email.

We'll try our best to take all valid feedback into consideration when adjusting and creating the rest of the game.

Thank you again and we hope you enjoy our game,

Kind Regards,

MGGEDev
